text:
jamie: pushed a small follow-up to PR #4821 — addressed @rachel's comments, switched the redis key namespace to avoid collisions, and added a minimal smoke test. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 :pray:

devops-bot: CI started for PR #4821 (build, unit, integration-redis)

rachel: thanks — quick Q: did you keep the TTL the same? worried about high memory for some buckets.

jamie: TTL kept at 30m. main change was the prefix only — from `kv:` -> `routing:kv:` to isolate routing cache entries. added a smoke test that asserts prefix and basic roundtrip. snippet: ```diff
- key = f'kv:{req.id}'
+ key = f'routing:kv:{req.id}'
```

samir: can you run a quick perf replay? curious if the extra prefix choked any hotspots or changed alignment in our cache keys.

jamie: ran a 1k-request replay locally against the recording — hit ratio roughly the same (89.2% -> 89.1%), median p50 latency +3ms (within noise). uploaded microbench: https://internal.redwood/perf/4821-replay (private link).

lucas: heads up CI is red on `integration-redis` step: `connection timed out to redis:6379`. seen this flake before during peak runner load.

devops-bot: CI: job integration-redis failed for PR #4821 — redis service timed out. To retry: `ci rerun integration-redis`.

rachel: I can rerun the job. Do we want to gate merge on a green `integration-redis`?

jamie: yes please gate on it. I re-ran locally and added a retry wrapper in the test harness to cut flakiness. re-run request in CI submitted.

devops-bot: CI re-run queued — integration-redis now passed, all checks green.

jamie: pushed one more commit fixing a docstring style nit and added a note to the PR about fallback behavior and the smoke command: `./scripts/smoke --env local --redis`. also added rollout notes: canary to `beta-1` for 30m.

samir: LGTM from me assuming CI stays green. @rachel want to take final look?

rachel: one tiny nit left on the README line wrap, I left an inline comment. otherwise good. if you address it i'll approve and you can merge in tomorrow's 10:30-11:30 PT merge window.

jamie: fixed the README wrap and pushed. thanks! scheduling canary for tomorrow morning as planned.

lucas: approving now.

rachel: approved :rocket:

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for canary:beta-1 PR#4821 — monitoring hooks enabled.
